name: nyom-locator-api
description: Nyom Locator API - health services, markets, police stations and churches

scripts.install:services: npm install --prefix services/gateway && npm install --prefix services/user-service && npm install --prefix services/places-service && npm install --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm install --prefix services/assistant-service
scripts.dev:recommendation: cross-env PORT=4003 PLACES_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4002 USER_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4001 node services/recommendation-service/server.js
scripts.dev:assistant: cross-env PORT=4004 PLACES_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4002 USER_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4001 node services/assistant-service/server.js
scripts.dev:gateway: cross-env PORT=3000 USER_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4001 PLACES_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4002 RECOMMENDATION_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4003 ASSISTANT_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4004 node services/gateway/server.js
scripts.test:services: npm test --prefix services/user-service && npm test --prefix services/places-service && npm test --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm test --prefix services/assistant-service
